# ribattseke.co.za

> Riba T Tseke — Installation Electrician (Wireman's Licence, NQF 6) with 10+ years in renewable energy operations, quality leadership, and accredited trade assessment. Based in Gauteng, South Africa.

This site serves South African electricians and trade students preparing for the NAMB Electrical Trade Test. It provides structured LMS study sessions on SANS 10142-1 (Installation Rules), practice quizzes, professional services, and study resources.

## Services

- [Sessions](/sessions): Installation Rules (SANS 10142-1) structured study sessions and trade test preparation
- [Resources](/resources): Study packs, SANS books, compliance instruments, and stationery
- [Projects](/projects): Technical consultation, training panel builds, Installation Rules facilitation, and compliance instrument training
- [Study](/study): LMS with timed quizzes covering SANS 10142-1, EIR 1992, Construction Regulations, and related standards

## About

- [About](/about): Qualifications, registrations, memberships, contact, and professional background
